context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress Packets of 1Hz Telemetry Samples from IoT edge devices, bike computers and smart wearables; device-initiated, immediate, backpressure-controlled.
context_map.boundary_protection: Device payload formats are adopted as-is; t_ingress is recorded at entry and never used for ordering; samples are validated against Sensor Metric Boundaries before propagation; device internals never leak downstream.

context_map.direction: Sample Ingestion & Validation -> Backfill Reordering & Windowing
context_map.exchanged_information: Events TelemetrySampleValidated and TelemetrySampleValidationFailed (VALIDATION_FAILED samples retained, not dropped); eventual, consumed reactively.
context_map.boundary_protection: Only the two published events cross; validation rules, Sensor Metric Boundary definitions and intake internals stay private. Consumers keep ordering by t_device.

context_map.direction: Sample Ingestion & Validation -> Telemetry Event Log
context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetrySampleValidated and TelemetrySampleValidationFailed events appended as raw records; eventual.
context_map.boundary_protection: Same published events as the reordering consumer; the log never validates or reorders and never mutates history; validation status travels as a tag.

context_map.direction: Backfill Reordering & Windowing -> Telemetry Event Log
context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetrySampleBackfilled events carrying corrective/backfilled frames, appended as Event Revisions; eventual.
context_map.boundary_protection: Only backfilled frames cross, never window buffers; the log appends Event Revisions and rejects any update/delete. Retry vs correction identity is unresolved (flagged).

context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetryWindowBuffered and OrderedTelemetryStreamBroadcast to streaming analytics consumers (PulseStream Engine), backpressure-aware.
context_map.boundary_protection: Consumers get only ordered, windowed streams as a stable published contract; reorder-window internals stay private.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Live 1Hz telemetry ingestion, validation and ordered broadcast
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual; non-blocking with backpressure; ordering by t_device within the 60-second window.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Validated and VALIDATION_FAILED samples both continue downstream; failures never drop payload. Metrics without ranges (ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke) cannot be validated yet - flagged for discovery.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Append-only audit history of raw records and revisions
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual; append-only, corrections as new Event Revisions.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Flagged: transport delivery semantics and dedup identity are undefined; samples later than 60s are unspecified between Reordering and Event Log. Telemetry Event Log publishes TelemetryRevisionAppended with no consumer in this slice. No coupling cycles.
